label: restricted to context
type: the subject may appear only in the object syntactic position, clause, or context.
note: Folds restrictedToClause, minted in the same wave by the same batch for the same shape (one about a clause, one about a position within a clause - not a distinction worth two predicates). Covers RIGHT OUTER JOIN being legal only in the FROM clause, and FLATTEN_KEYS only inside an array index definition.
